visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose the full analytical route before details.
visual_records.exact_reading: The Summary names assignment, two HCN graphs, four turnover factors, three dynamic events, 30.01 sigma budget, occupancy failure, promotion, and multiplex/HR extensions.
visual_records.next_action: Check every preview against its source model and result.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Freeze symbols and expose notation residue.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 1 binds personnel graph G, organization graph g, distance, turnover rate, intention, closeness, salary ability proxy, and hierarchy; stray Emu/C entries are not used downstream.
visual_records.next_action: Publish a consistent symbol/unit dictionary and remove unused entries.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Connect qualitative rules to optimization.
visual_records.exact_reading: Four principles become E1-E4 and signed Equation (1); the nearby prose chooses GA because the assignment is already a gene representation.
visual_records.next_action: Release coefficient experiments, GA operators, seeds, convergence, and comparator results.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the recovered assignment inspectable.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 1 places job types across CEO, office, director, manager, and branch layers, with repeated blocks simplified by legend symbols.
visual_records.next_action: Release the machine-readable employee-to-office mapping.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Show the topology created from assignment rules.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 2 colors hierarchy levels, labels three edge types and example clusters, and explicitly omits some edges for conciseness.
visual_records.next_action: Release the complete weighted edge list and layout settings.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate topological importance from title.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 3 uses node color for office level and size for LeaderRank; Production Manager appears more important than VP despite formal hierarchy.
visual_records.next_action: Publish LeaderRank settings and test the surprise on observed outcomes.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make three turnover mechanisms inspectable.
visual_records.exact_reading: Revised RA similarity feeds a logistic departure influence, while employee closeness and department LeaderRank feed an inverse centrality factor.
visual_records.next_action: Define beta, components, normalization, direct neighbors, and scale sensitivity.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose the factor synthesis.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 4 connects contagion, employee centrality, salary, and promotion prospect to employee alternatives, followed by a visibly nonreciprocal judgment matrix and score labeled (2).
visual_records.next_action: Repair the matrix, recompute CI/CR and weights, and correct the equation reference.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Bind promotion eligibility to position level.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 2 gives SM/JM/ES/IS/EE/IE thresholds 8/5/3/2/1/0 and excludes Administrative Clerks and non-promotable Senior Managers.
visual_records.next_action: Validate thresholds, units, truncation, and exclusion consequences.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn a network mechanism into a temporal visual comparison.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 5 shows a departure-pressure cluster moving through structurally similar nodes and labels relatively high mid-level turnover intention.
visual_records.next_action: Release node identities, raw intention values, seeds, and replications.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate direct staff loss from indirect intention effects.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figures 6 and 7 show declining level contributions, higher middle-manager intention, repeated shocks, and a reported 9.8% average-productivity reduction by month 24.
visual_records.next_action: Provide raw series, uncertainty bands, and observed productivity.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Explain curve shape before summing budget.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 8 shows volatile recruiting cost and smooth declining training cost, which the prose attributes to Poisson arrivals versus staff composition.
visual_records.next_action: Release cost units, source values, event counts, and seeds.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn same-scale scenarios into an occupancy check.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 9 compares 18%, 25%, and 35% on one axis; approximate month-24 levels are about 258, 218, and 162, all below 80% of 370.
visual_records.next_action: Reconcile the prose boundary and state tolerance and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Show the downstream staffing cost of immediate promotion.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 10 keeps higher-level contributions relatively stable while low-level employee contribution declines, matching the stated promotion tradeoff.
visual_records.next_action: Compare delayed, capacity-constrained, and external-hiring policies.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Check whether service-time spread changes task-5 outputs.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 3 reports promoted count, average productivity, senior-manager productivity, and middle-manager number for l, 2l, and 3l service-time spread settings.
visual_records.next_action: Run replicated sweeps with uncertainty and raw values.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Audit the second sensitivity claim.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 4 repeats every Table 3 value and still labels columns l, 2l, and 3l although the prose claims lower, median, and upper means.
visual_records.next_action: Treat the table as unresolved until independently regenerated.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make omitted relationship information visible.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 11 places Human Capital and hometown networks on the same nodes and highlights a tie present in one layer but not the other.
visual_records.next_action: Collect observed layer edges and validate cross-layer predictions.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn extensions into inspectable operations.
visual_records.exact_reading: Jaccard measures simultaneous edges; evaluation and job vectors lead through Euclidean distance to an argmin position choice.
visual_records.next_action: Specify dimensions, scaling, missingness, outcomes, privacy, and fairness.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Keep contribution claims auditable.
visual_records.exact_reading: The paper links strengths to network complexity, sensitivity, and common sense, but offers no independent outcome validation.
visual_records.next_action: Downgrade correctness claims to bounded internal evidence.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: End the paper at its actual evidence boundary.
visual_records.exact_reading: The final two weaknesses admit incomplete personnel composition and common-sense parameters caused by few data, with sensitivity invoked only for slight changes.
visual_records.next_action: Carry both limitations into every reuse.
